TEMPORAL ACTION OWNERSHIP: If CURRENT JOB assigns action X to THIS beat, require the candidate to narrate X as an event that happens now. Reject even when the completed state matches the desired result and later CURRENT JOB parts are shown correctly. Accept only if the candidate also narrates the causative action itself in this beat.

CURRENT JOB

CANDIDATE BEAT
The operator pulls the release lever; the primary blast door slides open, and the operator walks into the chamber.
